The lyrics were written by their frontman Robert Smith, who drew inspiration from a past trip to the sea shore with his future wife.  Before Smith had completed the lyrics, an instrumental version of the song was used as the theme for the French television show "Les Enfants du Rock".

Les McKeown | Leslie Richard McKeown (born 12 November 1955) is a Scottish pop singer who was the lead singer of the Bay City Rollers during their most successful period.
